plugins.name: input-router
plugins.description: Big file reads and connector results go to Haiku first; Claude gets short notes and the path to the full text.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Haiku judges each subagent task and moves easy ones to a cheaper model. Never changes the main chat.

plugins.name: efficient-browser-use
plugins.description: Shrinks browser screenshots before Claude reads them.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a summary of a long chat from its prompt cache, so a fresh agent node can carry on from it.

plugins.name: effort-advisor
plugins.description: Haiku suggests the effort level each prompt needs; the context meter offers to switch.

plugins.name: keep-warm
plugins.description: Pings a chat's prompt cache before it expires, for nodes you turn it on for. Each ping costs a cache read.

plugins.name: research-router
plugins.description: Gives Claude a Research tool: a Haiku subagent reads the pages and returns a short brief with sources.
